findings.motion: Military Voter Overseas Technical Enhancement (VOTE) Act, introduced as the lead sponsor
findings.note: Bill he introduced. It would require states to accept voter registration and absentee ballot requests online or by email, send ballots electronically by default, keep absentee status across elections without reapplying, and bar rejecting applications for early submission. The release does not mention ID or proof of citizenship. Bill number not confirmed because congress.gov was blocked.
